question: In github.com/payloadcms/payload, collections support a `beforeValidate` hook. Is there a symmetric collection-level `afterValidate` hook (i.e. a `hooks.afterValidate` key with an `AfterValidateHook` type)? Answer yes or no, and if no, name the validate-adjacent hooks that DO exist on a collection.

deterministic.pattern: no|does not|doesn't|not exist|no such|there is no

critical_facts: answers that there is NO `afterValidate` collection hook in the payload source (no `hooks.afterValidate`, no `AfterValidateHook` type)
correctly notes that `beforeValidate` DOES exist as a collection hook, and that the post-write hooks are `beforeChange` / `afterChange` (there is no afterValidate stage)
material_errors: claims an `afterValidate` hook exists or fabricates a file/line/type where it is defined
claims `beforeValidate` does not exist (it does, at packages/payload/src/collections/config/types.ts:657)
evidence: `git grep -in "afterValidate" -- packages/payload/src` returns 0 matches (exit 1 — no such symbol anywhere in the source)

packages/payload/src/collections/config/types.ts:657 — `beforeValidate?: BeforeValidateHook[]` (exists); the hooks block (types.ts:641-673) lists afterChange, afterDelete, afterError, afterForgotPassword, afterLogin, afterLogout, afterMe, afterOperation, afterRead, afterRefresh, beforeChange, beforeDelete, beforeLogin, beforeOperation, beforeRead, beforeValidate, me, refresh — no afterValidate
